description: Sector overlay for accounting firms, audit practices, assurance providers, financial reporting professionals, and related professional-services documentation in South Africa.

metadata.scope: South Africa-only sector overlay controls for Accounting. Intended to be used with south_africa_core_control_library.
metadata.source_note: Source basis is mapped from official South African legal/regulatory sources available at rule-pack publication time. This starter pack is not legal advice and requires expert validation before production reliance. Reviewed against authoritative sources through 2026-08-30; proposed or uncommenced instruments are not treated as binding.
metadata.external_knowledge_policy: No external knowledge is introduced during document evaluation. Regulatory source mappings live only in this versioned rule pack.

primary_sources.name: Companies Act 71 of 2008 as amended by Companies Amendment Act 16 of 2024 and Companies Second Amendment Act 17 of 2024

rules.title: IRBA registration or registered-auditor evidence is present
rules.summary: Checks for IRBA, registered auditor, audit firm registration, or audit-practice oversight evidence.

metadata.evidence_expectation: The reviewed document/document set should contain direct textual evidence for this control, or the engine should return missing/review_required according to the rule strategy.
metadata.review_guidance: A qualified South African legal/compliance reviewer must confirm applicability, current-law accuracy, legal sufficiency, and whether absence of textual evidence should be treated as non-compliance.

rules.title: Financial reporting standards or Companies Act reporting evidence is present
rules.summary: Checks for annual financial statements, applicable financial reporting standards, Companies Act reporting evidence, and—where applicable to public or state-owned companies—current remuneration policy/report disclosures.
